name: Major wine weekends
tagline: The recurring cellar-door weekends that make the Peninsula work beyond summer.
summary: Major wine weekends are the Peninsula’s repeatable reason to travel when the beach is not the point: Winter Wine Weekend, winery long lunches, cellar-door open days, truffle-season pairings and smaller producer-led programs across Red Hill, Main Ridge, Merricks and Balnarring.
monthAnchor: Year-round, strongest in winter and harvest
location: Red Hill, Main Ridge, Merricks, Balnarring
heroImageAlt: Mornington Peninsula vineyard rows in wine country
whatItIs:
An overview hub for recurring wine-country weekends that deserve annual coverage but may not each need a permanent standalone page. Winter Wine Weekend is the flagship; around it sit harvest-season cellar-door activity, truffle-season lunches, producer-led tastings, restaurant collaborations and open-cellar programs that move between wineries.

The editorial role is to sort the serious wine weekends from ordinary promotional packages. A Signature Event listing should point readers to recurring, region-shaping programs — not every cellar-door offer with a date attached.
whoItsFor: Couples, wine travellers, long-lunch planners, food-and-wine groups and Melbourne visitors who want the Peninsula at a slower pace. It suits people willing to book lunch, limit the number of stops, arrange a driver and treat the accommodation as part of the plan rather than an afterthought.
peninsulaCalendarContext: Wine weekends are what keep the Peninsula legible outside summer. They connect the region’s strongest inland places — Red Hill, Main Ridge, Merricks and Balnarring — and give the editorial calendar a reliable structure around harvest, winter, truffle season and spring releases.
gettingThere: The wine country is spread out and public transport is not the tool for this job. Choose a base, book lunch first, then work backwards into tastings. Red Hill and Main Ridge are the most central bases; Flinders, Merricks and Balnarring suit slower stays; Sorrento and Mornington work if you are happy to drive in and out.
editorialNotes: Overview page created to satisfy Emma brief item “major wine weekends” without over-promoting unverified small events. MPVA URL used as broad official industry source.
